Hi Samir/Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap from my side: 
- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood for low-latency, cost-predictable inference for transaction risk scoring (50k reqs/day, 1-2s SLA).
- Key constraints: PCI-adjacent data handling, SSO, and a tight procurement window for Q2 budget.
- Success signals: pilot with 1 model in prod, <10ms median token latency target at our typical seq lengths, and predictable per-token cost.

Next step: 30-minute product intro + light technical overview so we can align on architecture and scope. Aditya (cc'd) will cover infra/SSO and typical deployment patterns. Would any of these work for your team?

1) Wed Mar 24 — 10:00-10:30 PT
2) Wed Mar 24 — 15:00-15:30 PT
3) Thu Mar 25 — 09:00-09:30 PT

I've attached a short deck to give you context ahead of the call. If you have any scheduling conflicts or want a longer technical deep-dive, tell us which stakeholders should join and we can extend.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
